SELECT (
  SELECT json_build_object('id', id, 'vendor', vendor, 'invoiceNumber', "invoiceNumber")
  FROM "Expense"
  WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL AND $3::numeric IS NOT NULL AND $4::text IS NOT NULL AND (
    (
      $2::text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim($2::text)) > 0
      AND "invoiceNumber" IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(vendor) = LOWER(trim($1::text))
      AND LOWER("invoiceNumber") = LOWER(trim($2::text))
      AND amount = $3::numeric
      AND UPPER(currency) = UPPER(trim($4::text))
    )
    OR
    (
      ($2::text IS NULL OR length(trim($2::text)) = 0)
      AND $5::date IS NOT NULL
      AND "invoiceNumber" IS NULL
      AND LOWER(vendor) = LOWER(trim($1::text))
      AND "expenseDate"::date = $5::date
      AND amount = $3::numeric
      AND UPPER(currency) = UPPER(trim($4::text))
    )
  )
  ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS "matchedCandidate";

INSERT INTO "Expense" (
  "id",
  "idempotencyKey",
  "expenseDate",
  "vendor",
  "invoiceNumber",
  "description",
  "amount",
  "currency",
  "taxAmount",
  "subtotalAmount",
  "category",
  "validationStatus",
  "validationIssues",
  "sourceFileName",
  "createdAt",
  "updatedAt"
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3::timestamp,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  $7::numeric,
  $8,
  $9::numeric,
  $10::numeric,
  $11,
  $12,
  $13::jsonb,
  $14,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("idempotencyKey") DO UPDATE SET "updatedAt" = "Expense"."updatedAt"
RETURNING *;
